user_saw: On Discord and LINE, a long code block sent in newline chunk mode could arrive with an unclosed fence and a continuation outside the code block.
summary: The fix disables length-based splitting in the planner’s plain-text paragraph pass so the channel chunker can split long fenced code blocks and close each part correctly.
reasoning: The July 1 snapshot already used plain-text length splitting on oversized paragraphs before passing them to Discord’s fence-aware chunker. I checked the later planner and paragraph-splitting diffs and found that they preserved this behavior. The offline history stopped at the shallow boundary, so I could not verify whether the defect shipped with newline chunking or broke a previously working delivery path.
